resources.string:
Sonder watches which app is in the foreground so it can block the apps you chose until you win a hand of blackjack.

That is all it does with the event stream: it reads the app package name, never the screen.

The one exception you are granting here: for an app you have set to block Reels or Shorts only, Sonder looks at the on-screen view identifiers to tell that short-video feed apart from the rest of the app, so your feed, messages and search stay usable. It reads only those identifier names — never any text, message, photo or video — and matches them against a fixed list. Nothing is stored, and nothing ever leaves your device.
